title: fracreg — Fractional Response Models
text: R package fitting testing specifications fractional regression models. handles fractional, univariate proportions, bounded data (0≤y≤10 \le y \le 1), provides estimators one-part, two-part (hurdle), three-part (double-inflated) models.

title: fracreg — Fractional Response Models
text: fracreg fully equipped handle complex data structures commonly found econometrics biostatistics: Univariate Fractional Models (fracreg): Fit standard 1-part models, hurdle 2-part models (mass 0 1), double-inflated 3-part models. Panel Data Models (fracregpd): Estimate fractional models fixed-T longitudinal data, supporting Correlated Random Effects (CRE) handle unobserved individual heterogeneity. Endogeneity & Heteroskedasticity (fracreghet): Correct endogenous covariates using Instrumental Variables (IV) via Control Function GMM approaches. Diagnostic Testing: Includes generalized goodness--functional-form (fracreg.ggoff), RESET (fracreg.reset), non-nested P-tests (fracreg.ptest). Analytical Partial Effects: Compute exact marginal effects model types (including 3-part composite effects) via Delta method using fracreg.pe().
